funding_data.required_source: Binance official USD-M Futures historical fundingRate archive represented by the verified canonical formal dataset
funding_data.holdout_rows: manifest/count metadata only; rates and labels are forbidden

primary_feature.name: FUNDING_90D_CAUSAL_PERCENTILE
primary_feature.history: the 270 settlements strictly preceding the current settlement; current event excluded

funding_availability.standalone_reference: open price of the first canonical 1m bar whose open_time_ms is strictly greater than settlement timestamp_ms
funding_availability.atr: latest fully closed frozen 1H ATR(14) and ATR percentile whose close_time_ms <= settlement timestamp_ms
funding_availability.opportunity_asof: latest settled funding timestamp_ms <= opportunity timestamp_ms using bisect_right
funding_availability.stale_rule: funding age > 8h + 5min is STALE_FUNDING and excluded

h19.statement: Extreme settled-funding crowding contains contrarian directional information for subsequent BTCUSDT returns.
h19.event_unit: tail funding settlement with complete 270-event warmup
h19.null_permutation: within same year and 1H ATR decile, permute LONG/SHORT labels preserving counts; 2000 simulations seed 37
h19.tail_spread: median raw return for bottom quartile minus median raw return for top quartile
h19.matched_tail_pairs: bottom vs top, same year and 1H ATR decile, K=1 nearest absolute settlement time with >=24h separation, earlier tie-break
h19.spearman: funding percentile versus future raw return; expected negative; secondary only
h19.uncertainty: UTC calendar-week cluster bootstrap, 2000 simulations, seed 37
h19.support: 4h/8h real signed medians >0; real-minus-permutation deltas >0; weekly-bootstrap p05 for real signed median >=-0.05 ATR; bottom-minus-top spreads >0 with weekly-bootstrap p05 >=-0.05; Spearman <0; Early and Late signed medians >0; LONG and SHORT subgroup medians >=-0.05 at both primary horizons
h19.falsify: both 4h and 8h signed medians <=0, or both bottom-top spreads <=0, or both real-minus-permutation deltas <=0

h20.statement: Funding extreme direction provides directional information on existing direction-agnostic BR/TP opportunity events.
h20.union: exact timestamp union of frozen BR_PATTERN and TP_PATTERN; preserve BR, TP, or BR+TP tag
h20.event_reference: original opportunity decision close and frozen 15m ATR
h20.primary_sample: opportunity event with latest non-stale settled funding and extreme Funding bias
h20.null_permutation: within year, frozen 15m ATR decile, and setup tag when feasible, permute Funding direction preserving counts
h20.uncertainty: UTC calendar-day cluster bootstrap, 2000 simulations, seed 37
h20.support: 4h/8h pooled signed medians >0; real-minus-permutation deltas >0; day-cluster p05 for real signed median >=-0.05; Early/Late medians >0; LONG/SHORT subgroup medians >=-0.05
h20.falsify: both pooled 4h and 8h signed medians <=0, or both real-minus-permutation deltas <=0
h20.setup_breakdowns: BR-only, TP-only, and BR+TP are secondary and cannot replace pooled verdict

h21.statement: Funding-conditioned opportunity events retain elevated direction-agnostic movement.
h21.controls: non-pattern trend-regime decision points matched same year, frozen 15m ATR decile, same funding tail side, >=24h separation; K=5 deterministic nearest, earlier tie-break, reuse allowed
h21.uncertainty: opportunity UTC-day cluster bootstrap, 2000 simulations, seed 37
h21.support: 4h/8h future-range and max-excursion deltas >0; future-range bootstrap p05 >=-0.05 at both; Early/Late future-range deltas >0
h21.falsify: future-range and max-excursion deltas are <=0 at both horizons, or future-range p95 <=0 at both
h21.below_gate: INCONCLUSIVE_LOW_SAMPLE when fewer than 30 complete 8h events or 20 day clusters

recommendation_gate.A_RECOMMEND_FUNDING_DIRECTION_PLUS_OPPOR: H19, H20, and H21 all SUPPORTED
recommendation_gate.B_RECOMMEND_FUNDING_DIRECTION_FOLLOWUP: H19 SUPPORTED and H20/H21 inconclusive rather than falsified
